title: Dolph-Chebyshev Minimax Equiripple QFT Stopband Sidelobe Suppression Window
claims: For any window size P and target mainlobe-to-sidelobe amplitude ratio R > 1, the Dolph-Chebyshev frequency polynomial T_{P-1}(x_0 cos(pi f)) / R has P - 2 equal-height stopband extrema of exact power ratio 1 / R^2.

At P = 16, R = 30 and P = 24, R = 40, the discrete Dolph-Chebyshev window achieves >35x lower peak stopband sidelobe power than the uniform box window and >3.5x lower peak stopband sidelobe power than the Dirichlet-sine window.
